items.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: Suzie” I was in love with the girl named Susan so-and-so.

ctx.x: He sings it beautifully, it’s very simple, I want to compare the two. It’s not that Fred’s arrangement is better, I just want them to hear what people do to color an arrangement or not color it. And I liken it to a coloring book, a black and white coloring book for kids. Look, you can keep the picture of the duck the same with the little bits of water, or you can color in the water or the grass green or make it yellowish or make the duck lighter. Whatever color. So that’s like brass or strings or whatever you…
